workflow_guid.title: Workflow Guid
workflow_guid.description: GUID of the workflow containing the node.

node_guid.title: Node Guid
node_guid.description: GUID of the node whose file/folder is being converted.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: GUID of the project the node belongs to.

path.title: Path
path.description: Path of the file or folder, relative to the node's own directory, to copy into the library.

type.title: Type
type.description: Kind of entry being converted: "file" or "folder".

library_name.title: Library Name
library_name.description: Name of the target library. Created automatically if it doesn't exist yet.

description.title: Description
description.description: Description to use when the target library is newly created. Ignored if the library already exists.
